lessonTitle: 70. Sides and angles of a triangle
lessonTitleEnglish: Sides and angles of a triangle
unit: Geometry · Chapter 4. Sides and angles of a triangle
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 7 mathematics textbooks

stages.headline: Theorem: the larger side of a triangle lies opposite the larger angle, and conversely.
stages.headlineEnglish: Theorem: the larger side of a triangle lies opposite the larger angle, and conversely.

stages.headline: Corollary 1: the hypotenuse is longer than a leg. Corollary 2: a triangle with two equal angles is isosceles.
stages.headlineEnglish: Corollary 1: the hypotenuse is longer than a leg. Corollary 2: a triangle with two equal angles is isosceles.

stages.headline: Example: ∠A = 80°, ∠B = 60°, ∠C = 40°, so the sides order as BC > AC > AB.
stages.headlineEnglish: Example: ∠A = 80°, ∠B = 60°, ∠C = 40°, so the sides order as BC > AC > AB.
